headerDisplay: Expose video streams as HomeKit motion sensors using on-device object detection. Add one **Stream** per source/camera, then add **Sensors** to it.
footerDisplay:
### How sensors work

Each **Sensor** becomes one HomeKit motion sensor that triggers when **any** of its selected categories is detected above the threshold.

- **Categories** — `animals`, `packages`, `people`, `vehicles`. Select one or more; the sensor fires on any of them.
- **Name** — optional. Leave blank to auto-name it (prefixed with the stream name, e.g. *Garden Animals & People Sensor*). A name you enter is used verbatim and must be unique across all streams.
- **Threshold** — optional confidence cutoff from 0–1 (default `0.5`). Lower = more sensitive, more false positives.

name.title: Name
name.description: Plugin name as displayed in the Homebridge log.

name.title: Stream Name
name.description: Used as a prefix for auto-named sensors, e.g. "Garden" → "Garden Animals Sensor"

checkInterval.title: Check interval (seconds)
checkInterval.description: Seconds between detection checks for all sensors on this stream. Defaults to 2. Lower values respond sooner and use more CPU. Checks may take longer if inference is slow.

name.title: Name (optional)
name.description: Leave blank to auto-name. If set, used verbatim and must be unique.

logStatus.title: Log sensor status changes
logStatus.description: When enabled, this sensor logs to the Homebridge log whenever it switches between detected and idle. Leave unchecked to keep the log quiet (changes are still logged at debug level).

items.title: 📡 Sensors
items.description: Add at least one sensor. Each becomes a HomeKit motion sensor that triggers when its selected categories are detected.
